mapper.select: /* GroupQueryMapper.findGroupList */ SELECT gi.cla_id AS claId, gi.group_nm AS groupNm, gi.school_level AS schoolLevel, gi.grade AS grade, gi.class_number AS classNumber, gi.school_name AS schoolName, gi.invite_code AS inviteCode, gi.use_yn AS useYn, gi.created_at AS createdAt, CASE WHEN gi.host_user_no = #{userNo} THEN 'HOST' ELSE 'STUDENT' END AS myRole, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM group_member gm2 WHERE gm2.group_id = gi.group_id AND gm2.status = 'ACTIVE') AS memberCount FROM group_info gi LEFT JOIN group_member gm ON gm.group_id = gi.group_id AND gm.user_no = #{userNo} AND gm.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE gi.use_yn = 'Y' AND (gi.host_user_no = #{userNo} OR gm.id IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY gi.created_at DESC

/* GroupQueryMapper.findGroupMemberList */ SELECT gm.id AS id, gm.group_id AS groupId, gm.user_no AS userNo, gm.stdt_id AS stdtId, gm.nickname AS nickname, gm.gender AS gender, gm.email AS email, gm.member_type AS memberType, gm.member_no AS memberNo, gm.status AS status, gm.joined_at AS joinedAt FROM group_member gm WHERE gm.group_id = #{groupId} ORDER BY gm.member_no ASC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

/* GroupQueryMapper.findGroupDetail */ SELECT gi.group_id AS groupId, gi.cla_id AS claId, gi.host_user_no AS hostUserNo, gi.group_nm AS groupNm, gi.group_desc AS groupDesc, gi.school_level AS schoolLevel, gi.grade AS grade, gi.class_number AS classNumber, gi.school_name AS schoolName, gi.invite_code AS inviteCode, gi.max_member_count AS maxMemberCount, gi.use_yn AS useYn, gi.created_at AS createdAt, u.nickname AS hostNickname FROM group_info gi JOIN `user` u ON u.user_no = gi.host_user_no WHERE gi.group_id = #{groupId}

/* GroupQueryMapper.findGuestMembersByEmail */ SELECT gm.id AS memberId, gi.cla_id AS claId, gm.stdt_id AS stdtId, gm.nickname AS nickname, gm.gender AS gender, gm.email AS email, gi.group_nm AS groupNm, gi.grade AS grade, gm.joined_at AS joinedAt FROM group_member gm JOIN group_info gi ON gi.group_id = gm.group_id WHERE gm.email = #{email} AND gm.user_no IS NULL AND gm.member_type = 'GUEST' AND gm.status = 'ACTIVE'
